sources.entry: Songifted - Creates personalized AI song gifts from names and memories, with lyrics approval before recording, a free 45-second preview, and paid full songs. #paid

summary.name: Songifted
summary.one_liner: Songifted is a web service that turns a name, memories and a message into an AI-written, AI-sung personalized song, such as a birthday song with the recipient's name in it.
use_cases: Making a birthday song with a friend's name in it
Creating an anniversary song for a partner
Writing a song for a parent or family member
Producing a last-minute gift for a party
Making a custom wedding or first dance song
Creating a memorial song to keep someone's memory close
summary.what_it_does: Songifted takes a few words from the user (the recipient's name, relationship, occasion and message) and writes original lyrics with the name included. The user reads the full lyrics, can edit them manually or request up to three AI rewrites, and only then is audio generated. The page says songs are fully sung with verses, chorus and bridge, run about 3 minutes, and can be sung in one of nine styles with a chosen tone and voice (male, female, duet or choir). Buyers receive an MP3 download and a shareable gift page with the lyrics.
notable: Lyrics are reviewed and can be edited before any audio is generated
Free 45-second preview for eligible first-time creators
Choice of nine music styles, tones and vocal options including choir and duet
Delivers an MP3 plus a shareable gift page with lyrics
caveats: Full songs cost from $49; free preview is only for eligible first-time creators
Lyric edits are unavailable once audio generation starts
Full song is about 3 minutes; examples on the page are 1-minute excerpts
Example songs and the Sarah sample are AI-generated dramatizations, not customer songs
